authoritative: America/New_York, this Macs zone, read from /etc/localtime.
rule: Routines fire on the Mac zone. The owner travels; owner-facing times are LABELLED when they are elsewhere rather than silently reinterpreted. A promise that shifts under the owner is worse than one occasionally in the wrong zone, because they cannot predict it.
pendant: Has no zone and must not be given one by inference. No NITZ, no GNSS, zoneless device digits. Parsing those must return a null instant rather than borrowing the Mac zone.
status: A default, not a discovered fact. Keep it a value that can be changed.
